info.name: Render Public Audit Logs Deploys API

params.name: status
params.description: Filter for deploys with the specified statuses

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Filter for deploys created before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Filter for deploys created after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: updatedBefore
params.description: Filter for deploys updated before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: updatedAfter
params.description: Filter for deploys updated after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: finishedBefore
params.description: Filter for deploys finished before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: finishedAfter
params.description: Filter for deploys finished after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: cursor
params.description: The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

items.docs: List deploys matching the provided filters. If no filters are provided, all deploys for the service are returned.
Trigger a deploy for the service with the provided ID.
Retrieve the details of a particular deploy for a particular service.

Cancel an in-progress deploy for a service.

Not supported for cron jobs.

Trigger a rollback to a previous deploy of the specified service.

Triggering a rollback with this endpoint does not disable autodeploys for the service. This means an autodeploy might restore changes you had intentionally rolled back.

You can toggle autodeploys for your service with the [Update service](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/update-service) endpoint or in the Render Dashboard.
